systems.owner: Ministry of ICT, Postal and Courier Services

ZWE.note: Platform is planned, and is a data and computing platform, not an AI system in administration use.
Health, agriculture and education uses are only potential applications.

facts.fact: The article says Pangolin AI is part of Zimbabwe's National AI Strategy 2026-2030, which sets out the country's approach to developing and deploying AI.

Zimbabwe's ICT minister Tatenda Mavetera said Pangolin AI, the national AI platform giving secure local computing and national data to startups, developers and researchers, will be fully operational by Q1 2027.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT, Postal and Courier Services

ZWE.note: Local data storage is a platform design feature, not a stated rule requiring data to stay in the country.
No startup law, label or fund stated; access to the platform is not a startup scheme.
No hub, incubator or park stated.
